solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sound like pet with no tail and carry out action for dog

indicators.note: with no tail says the last letter of the purring word is cut off

parts.note: a pet cat's contented sound is a purr
to sue is to carry out legal action against someone

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about a tailless pet making noises and some action involving a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: To dog someone is to follow them doggedly, i.e. to chase or hound them.

clue.text: After change in direction, tennis competition is closed

indicators.note: a change in direction swaps one compass point for another, here south becoming north

parts.note: the US Open is a Grand Slam tennis championship

explanation.surface: A tennis tournament shut down after some rerouting.
explanation.walkthrough: In US OPEN the S (south) becomes N (north).
explanation.definitionFit: Something not opened remains shut, the same as closed.

clue.text: Minister used bacon in a strange way

indicators.note: doing something in a strange way signals that these letters are rearranged oddly

explanation.surface: A clergyman who handled his breakfast bacon oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: A subdeacon is a cleric ranking just below a deacon, a minor minister of the church.

clue.text: All English, mighty lot

parts.note: mighty as an informal intensifier, as in mighty fine, means very
a lot of people is a body of them

explanation.surface: A boast that all the English are a mighty crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: All, used of people, means every person, the whole lot of them.

clue.text: Behind bars after arrest, ultimately

indicators.note: after says the bars come later than the letter from arrest
ultimately points to the final letter of the word arrest

parts.note: a railing is a fence made of bars

explanation.surface: Someone ends up behind bars once finally arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: Trailing in a race means lagging behind the others.

clue.text: Cut some weed, is pothead around?

indicators.note: around says the run of letters is turned the other way
some of the words means a run of letters taken from inside them

explanation.surface: A drug-themed question: is the stoner hanging about to cut some cannabis?
explanation.definitionFit: Topside is a lean cut of beef from the upper hindquarter.

clue.text: Up in the morning, snog toplessly

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, marks the morning hours

indicators.note: toplessly means the first letter is removed, here from a word for snog

parts.note: snog is British slang for kiss

explanation.surface: Waking early for a topless kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking what's up means asking what's wrong, so up can mean awry.

clue.text: 1,000 in Asian country reaching African port

indicators.note: in places the thousand inside the name of the Asian country

parts.note: Laos is a country in South-East Asia
G (for grand) stands for a thousand

explanation.surface: A thousand travellers in an Asian land reaching a port in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Lagos is Nigeria's largest city and a major seaport on the Gulf of Guinea.

clue.text: Gassed wine inferior to coffee that's new for line

indicators.note: that's new for line asks for the line letter to be swapped out for one meaning new
inferior to means below, so in this down answer the wine sits beneath the coffee

parts.note: a latte is a milky coffee
red is wine of that colour

explanation.surface: Fizzy wine judged worse than coffee, with something new replacing the line.
explanation.walkthrough: LATTERED has its L (line) replaced by N (new).
explanation.definitionFit: Gassed is informal for chatted at length, just as natter means idle talk.

clue.text: Show signs of enjoying comedy pair

definitions.meaning: to bend over helpless with laughter at something funny
a double act, two comedians working as a pair

explanation.surface: Showing appreciation of a comedy double act.
explanation.definitionFit: One doubles over laughing, and a comic double act is two performers paired together.

clue.text: Castings? When penniless, opt to appear in half of them

indicators.note: to appear in means placed inside the letters from half of them

parts.note: them refers back to castings, and its second half is the run INGS

indicators.note: penniless says the P (penny) is removed from the word opt

explanation.surface: An audition story: broke actors opting to appear in half the castings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'them' points back to 'Castings', the definition; the back half of CASTINGS is INGS.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingots are blocks of metal produced by pouring into moulds, so they are castings.

clue.text: Vocal vendor introducing unknown vegetable

indicators.note: vocal says the word for vendor is spoken rather than written

parts.note: a vendor is a seller
Y is one of the algebraic unknowns

explanation.surface: A loud market trader presenting a mystery vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Celery is a vegetable grown for its crisp edible stalks.

clue.text: Maintained tidiness after having a shift around

indicators.note: shifting things around rearranges them, signalling the word tidiness is reordered

explanation.surface: Someone kept insisting that neatness came after moving the furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a claim is to assert it firmly, the same as insisting on it.

clue.text: Experimental noodle chef possesses nothing very like goat

indicators.note: an experimental dish is one put together in a new way, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: An avant-garde noodle cook who has nothing very goatlike about them.
explanation.definitionFit: Goats have split hooves divided into two toes.

clue.text: Making hay, richer can get up this

definitions.text: Making hay, richer can get up this

indicators.note: making here means producing something new from these letters, so they are reworked

explanation.surface: Making hay while the sun shines lets the wealthier climb the social ladder.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a richer person can climb a ranking ladder.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranked order of status is something people climb as they grow wealthier.

clue.text: Working to pen part of speech, mean to be pompous

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so the word for working surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: a machine that is working is on
a verb is one of the parts of speech
mean in the sense of base or contemptible is low

explanation.surface: A writer setting down part of a speech intends it to sound grand.
explanation.definitionFit: Overblown style is inflated and bombastic, which is how pompous writing reads.

clue.text: Opportunity to get on Casualty

parts.note: a lucky break is an opportunity
to get on in years is to age

explanation.surface: A chance for a job on the hospital drama Casualty.
explanation.walkthrough: Casualty is also a long-running BBC hospital drama, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: A casualty can be an item broken or lost, as in damage counted after a move.

clue.text: Sort of angry about knight, princess returned former lover's share of property

indicators.note: about says the jumbled letters go round the knight
sort of signals a loose version of the word angry, its letters shuffled

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight
Anne is the Princess Royal

indicators.note: returned means the former lover's word is read backwards

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: A cross tale of a knight and a princess returning an old flame's share of property.
explanation.walkthrough: A GRANNY ANNEXE is a British term for a self-contained flat added to a house for an elderly relative.
explanation.definitionFit: The extension is a portion of a family home set aside for an older relative.

clue.text: Constant work to support regulars in ongoing way

indicators.note: to support in a down answer means to sit underneath the other pieces
regulars in asks for every other letter of the word ongoing

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
OP, opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Steady work to back up the regulars in a continuing way.
explanation.definitionFit: Something never stopping or pausing is continuous and unceasing.

clue.text: Aim spear high to pierce first person? On the contrary

indicators.note: to pierce describes one piece going into another
on the contrary reverses the direction: the person goes into the jumbled letters, not the other way
high means intoxicated, so the word spear is in a jumbled state

parts.note: I is the first person singular pronoun

explanation.surface: Aim a spear high to run someone through, or rather the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire is to set one's sights on a goal, to aim for it.

clue.text: Zero information on course for virus, say

indicators.note: on in an across clue means coming after, so the zero and information follow the course

parts.note: a course or route is a path
zero looks like the letter O
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: No information available on the course a virus takes.
explanation.definitionFit: A virus is one example of a disease-causing microorganism.

clue.text: Egyptian god's heart sinks for some time

indicators.note: heart picks out the middle letter of the god's name
sinks in a down answer means that letter drops lower

parts.note: Horus is the falcon-headed Egyptian sky god

explanation.surface: An Egyptian deity's heart sinking for a while.
explanation.walkthrough: The central R of HORUS moves down one place.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of several sixty-minute periods is some time.

clue.text: Go without duck, mostly one revolting bird

indicators.note: without says the duck letter is removed from the word go

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of zero, the letter O

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a rebel is one in revolt

explanation.surface: Leaving without the duck, a mostly rebellious bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The grebe is a diving water bird with lobed feet.

clue.text: Bishop in a hurry makes you jump

indicators.note: in places the bishop inside the other pieces

parts.note: mush is a command to sled dogs to hurry along
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop in a rush gives you a start.
explanation.definitionFit: To jump someone is to attack them suddenly by surprise.

clue.text: Name covering a north European river

indicators.note: covering means the naming word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: to dub is to name

explanation.surface: A name that covers a river in northern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The Danube flows across central Europe to the Black Sea.

clue.text: Refresher on origins of this exotic crockery, like some plates

indicators.note: on in an across clue means following the earlier letters
origins of asks for the first letters of the next three words

parts.note: a tonic is a refreshing drink or pick-me-up

explanation.surface: A drink served on fancy china plates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plates' looks like crockery but means the slabs of the Earth's crust.
explanation.definitionFit: Geology's crustal plates are called tectonic plates.

clue.text: Retired copper hugs unmarried girl some time after crashing

indicators.note: hugs means the reversed letters wrap round the girl
retired means going back, so the copper's word is read backwards

parts.note: a peeler is old British slang for a policeman
Ms is a title for a woman, here standing in for an unmarried girl

explanation.surface: A former policeman embracing a single girl some while after an accident.
explanation.definitionFit: The phase of sleep with rapid eye movement and dreams comes a while after one crashes out.

clue.text: American wrench inside of jeep

parts.note: to wrench is to yank

indicators.note: inside of points to the middle letters of the word jeep

explanation.surface: An American tugging at the inside of a jeep.
explanation.definitionFit: A Yankee is an informal name for someone from the United States.
